p0.original: Merchants and manufacturers are not contented with the monopoly of the home market, but desire likewise the most extensive foreign sale for their goods. Their country has no jurisdiction in foreign nations, and therefore can seldom procure them any monopoly there. They are generally obliged, therefore, to content themselves with petitioning for certain encouragements to exportation.
p0.zh: 商家和制造商并不满足于国内市场的垄断,但同样也渴望获得最广泛的外国商品销售。 他们的国家对外国没有管辖权,因此很少能够在那里获得任何垄断。 因此,它们一般有义务满足于要求某些鼓励出口。

p1.original: Of these encouragements, what are called drawbacks seem to be the most reasonable. To allow the merchant to draw back upon exportation, either the whole, or a part of whatever excise or inland duty is imposed upon domestic industry, can never occasion the exportation of a greater quantity of goods than what would have been exported had no duty been imposed. Such encouragements do not tend to turn towards any particular employment a greater share of the capital of the country, than what would go to that employment of its own accord, but only to hinder the duty from driving away any part of that share to other employments. They tend not to overturn that balance which naturally establishes itself among all the various employments of the society, but to hinder it from being overturned by the duty. They tend not to destroy, but to preserve, what it is in most cases advantageous to preserve, the natural division and distribution of labour in the society.
p1.zh: 在这些鼓励中,所谓的缺点似乎是最合理的。允许商人收回出口,无论是全部还是对国内工业征收的消费税或内陆税的一部分,都不可能使出口货物的数量超过在没有征税的情况下本来会出口的货物。 这种鼓励往往不会转而用于任何特定就业,而只是妨碍义务将这种就业的任何部分转移到其他就业上。 他们往往不会推翻社会所有各种职业之间自然形成的平衡,而是阻碍社会被义务推翻。 他们往往不会破坏,而是保留在多数情况下对保护有利的社会劳动的自然分工和分配。

p2.original: The same thing may be said of the drawbacks upon the re-exportation of foreign goods imported, which, in Great Britain, generally amount to by much the largest part of the duty upon importation. By the second of the rules, annexed to the act of parliament, which imposed what is now called the old subsidy, every merchant, whether English or alien. was allowed to draw back half that duty upon exportation; the English merchant, provided the exportation took place within twelve months; the alien, provided it took place within nine months. Wines, currants, and wrought silks, were the only goods which did not fall within this rule, having other and more advantageous allowances. The duties imposed by this act of parliament were, at that time, the only duties upon the importation of foreign goods. The term within which this, and all other drawbacks could be claimed, was afterwards (by 7 Geo. I. chap. 21. sect. 10.) extended to three years.
p2.zh: 进口的外国货物在再出口方面的缺点也是一样,在大不列颠,进口时的关税一般占最大部分。议会法令附加了第二项规则,规定现在所谓的旧补贴,允许每名商人,无论是英国人还是外国人,在出口时都收回一半的关税;英国商人,条件是出口在12个月内进行;外国人,条件是在9个月内进行。葡萄酒、葡萄酒和丝绸是唯一不属于这一规则范围的物品,有其他更优惠的津贴。 当时,议会的这项法案规定的各项义务是进口外国货物的唯一义务。其后(7 Geo)提出了这一条件和所有其他缺点。 一、导 言21. 第21节。(10) 延长至三年。

p3.original: The duties which have been imposed since the old subsidy, are, the greater part of them, wholly drawn back upon exportation. This general rule, however, is liable to a great number of exceptions; and the doctrine of drawbacks has become a much less simple matter than it was at their first institution.
p3.zh: 自旧补贴以来,已规定的责任主要是全部依靠出口。 然而,这一一般规则可能有许多例外;弊端学说已经变得比最初的理论简单得多。

p4.original: Upon the exportation of some foreign goods, of which it was expected that the importation would greatly exceed what was necessary for the home consumption, the whole duties are drawn back, without retaining even half the old subsidy. Before the revolt of our North American colonies, we had the monopoly of the tobacco of Maryland and Virginia. We imported about ninety-six thousand hogsheads, and the home consumption was not supposed to exceed fourteen thousand. To facilitate the great exportation which was necessary, in order to rid us of the rest, the whole duties were drawn back, provided the exportation took place within three years.
p4.zh: 出口一些外国货物时,预计进口将大大超过家庭消费所必需的数额,因此全部关税被收回,甚至连原有补贴的一半也没有保留。 在我们的北美殖民地起义之前 我们垄断了马里兰州和弗吉尼亚州的烟草 我们进口了九万六千只猪头 家用量不应该超过一万四千只 为了促进必要的大出口,为了使我们摆脱其余部分,只要出口在三年内进行,就收回了全部责任。

p5.original: We still have, though not altogether, yet very nearly, the monopoly of the sugars of our West Indian islands. If sugars are exported within a year, therefore, all the duties upon importation are drawn back; and if exported within three years, all the duties, except half the old subsidy, which still continues to be retained upon the exportation of the greater part of goods. Though the importation of sugar exceeds a good deal what is necessary for the home consumption, the excess is inconsiderable, in comparison of what it used to be in tobacco.
p5.zh: 虽然我们还没有完全,但几乎仍然垄断着我们西印度群岛的糖。 因此,如果糖在一年内出口,进口时的所有关税都收回;如果在三年内出口,除了一半的旧补贴外,所有关税都收回,在出口大部分货物时,这些补贴仍然保留。 虽然进口糖量超过了家庭消费所需的数量,但与以前烟草相比,过量糖量是微不足道的。

p6.original: Some goods, the particular objects of the jealousy of our own manufacturers, are prohibited to be imported for home consumption. They may, however, upon paying certain duties, be imported and warehoused for exportation. But upon such exportation no part of these duties is drawn back. Our manufacturers are unwilling, it seems, that even this restricted importation should be encouraged, and are afraid lest some part of these goods should be stolen out of the warehouse, and thus come into competition with their own. It is under these regulations only that we can import wrought silks, French cambrics and lawns, calicoes, painted, printed, stained, or dyed, etc.
p6.zh: 一些商品,即我们自己厂商的妒忌行为的特定物品,禁止进口供家庭消费. 但是,在缴纳某些关税后,它们可以进口和储存出口。 但是,在出口时,这些责任中没有任何一部分被收回。 我们的制造商似乎不愿意鼓励这种限制性进口,并害怕这些商品的某些部分被从仓库中窃取,从而与自己的商品发生竞争。 只有根据这些条例,我们才能进口成品的丝绸、法国凸轮和草坪、焦土、油漆、印刷、污渍或染料等。

p7.original: We are unwilling even to be the carriers of French goods, and choose rather to forego a profit to ourselves than to suffer those whom we consider as our enemies to make any profit by our means. Not only half the old subsidy, but the second twenty-five per cent. is retained upon the exportation of all French goods.
p7.zh: 我们甚至不愿意成为法国货物的载体,而是选择放弃自己的利益,而不是遭受那些我们视为我们的敌人的人的伤害,以我们的手段谋取任何利润。出口所有法国商品时,不仅保留了一半的旧补贴,而且保留了25%的后25%。

p8.original: By the fourth of the rules annexed to the old subsidy, the drawback allowed upon the exportation of all wines amounted to a great deal more than half the duties which were at that time paid upon their importation; and it seems at that time to have been the object of the legislature to give somewhat more than ordinary encouragement to the carrying trade in wine. Several of the other duties, too which were imposed either at the same time or subsequent to the old subsidy, what is called the additional duty, the new subsidy, the one-third and two-thirds subsidies, the impost 1692, the tonnage on wine, were allowed to be wholly drawn back upon exportation. All those duties, however, except the additional duty and impost 1692, being paid down in ready money upon importation, the interest of so large a sum occasioned an expense, which made it unreasonable to expect any profitable carrying trade in this article. Only a part, therefore of the duty called the impost on wine, and no part of the twenty-five pounds the ton upon French wines, or of the duties imposed in 1745, in 1763, and in 1778, were allowed to be drawn back upon exportation. The two imposts of five per cent. imposed in 1779 and 1781, upon all the former duties of customs, being allowed to be wholly drawn back upon the exportation of all other goods, were likewise allowed to be drawn back upon that of wine. The last duty that has been particularly imposed upon wine, that of 1780, is allowed to be wholly drawn back; an indulgence which, when so many heavy duties are retained, most probably could never occasion the exportation of a single ton of wine. These rules took place with regard to all places of lawful exportation, except the British colonies in America.
p8.zh: 根据旧补贴所附规则中的第四项,所有葡萄酒出口时允许的退税数额大大超过当时进口时所付关税的一半;而且,在当时,立法机构似乎对葡萄酒的携带贸易给予比一般鼓励多一些的鼓励。 其他若干义务,也同时或继旧的补贴之后,又被规定为额外义务、新的补贴、三分之一和三分之二的补贴、1692年的印记、酒的吨位,允许全部收回出口。 然而,除了额外关税和1692年的附加关税以外,进口时以现成货币支付,如此之多的利息产生了一笔费用,因此无法指望本条中的任何有利可图的交易。 只有一部分义务,因此称为酒上的印货,25磅的吨位上法国葡萄酒,或1745年,1763年,1778年规定的关税中,没有一部分被允许在出口时收回.1779年和1781年对以前所有海关关税规定的5%的两个印记,允许全部收回所有其他货物出口,同样也允许收回葡萄酒。1780年对葡萄酒特别规定的最后一项义务是允许完全收回的;当保留如此多的重责时,这种宽大可能永远无法出口一吨葡萄酒。这些规则适用于所有合法出口地点,但英国在美国的殖民地除外。

p9.original: The 15th Charles II, chap. 7, called an act for the encouragement of trade, had given Great Britain the monopoly of supplying the colonies with all the commodities of the growth or manufacture of Europe, and consequently with wines. In a country of so extensive a coast as our North American and West Indian colonies, where our authority was always so very slender, and where the inhabitants were allowed to carry out in their own ships their non-enumerated commodities, at first to all parts of Europe, and afterwards to all parts of Europe south of Cape Finisterre, it is not very probable that this monopoly could ever be much respected; and they probably at all times found means of bringing back some cargo from the countries to which they were allowed to carry out one. They seem, however, to have found some difficulty in importing European wines from the places of their growth; and they could not well import them from Great Britain, where they were loaded with many heavy duties, of which a considerable part was not drawn back upon exportation. Madeira wine, not being an European commodity, could be imported directly into America and the West Indies, countries which, in all their non-enumerated commodities, enjoyed a free trade to the island of Madeira. These circumstances had probably introduced that general taste for Madeira wine, which our officers found established in all our colonies at the commencement of the war which began in 1755, and which they brought back with them to the mother country, where that wine had not been much in fashion before. Upon the conclusion of that war, in 1763 (by the 4th Geo. III, chap. 15, sect. 12), all the duties except £3, 10s. were allowed to be drawn back upon the exportation to the colonies of all wines, except French wines, to the commerce and consumption of which national prejudice would allow no sort of encouragement. The period between the granting of this indulgence and the revolt of our North American colonies, was probably too short to admit of any considerable change in the customs of those countries.
p9.zh: 第15届查理二世 第二章.7,称鼓励贸易的行为,使大不列颠垄断了向殖民地供应欧洲增长或制造的所有商品,并因此拥有葡萄酒.在一个象我们北美和西印度殖民地这样广阔的海岸上,我们的权力总是非常苗条,居民可以在其船上进行未经加工的商品,最初是到欧洲各地,后来又到菲尼斯特尔角以南的欧洲各地,这种垄断不大可能受到很大的尊重;他们可能随时都能找到从他们获准从事这种活动的国家运回一些货物的手段。 然而,他们似乎发现从种植地进口欧洲葡萄酒有一定困难;他们无法从英国进口葡萄酒,因为在那里,他们被装满许多重税,其中相当一部分没有从出口中抽回。 马德拉葡萄酒并非欧洲商品,可直接进口到美国和西印度群岛,这些国家在全部非商品中都享有与马德拉岛的自由贸易。这些情况可能已经带来了马德拉葡萄酒的一般口味,我们的军官们在1755年开始的战争开始时发现,这种葡萄酒在我们所有的殖民地都得到了确立,他们带着这种葡萄酒回到了祖国,那里以前这种葡萄酒并不怎么流行。这场战争结束后,1763年(由第四地球系). 页:1 页:1 除了3英镑,10英镑之外,所有的职责都允许在向殖民地出口除法国葡萄酒以外的所有葡萄酒后,回到商业和消费上,而国家偏见不允许对商业和消费进行任何鼓励。 从给予这种宽容到我们北美殖民地的叛乱,可能太短,无法承认这些国家的习俗有任何重大改变。

p10.original: The same act which, in the drawbacks upon all wines, except French wines, thus favoured the colonies so much more than other countries, in those upon the greater part of other commodities, favoured them much less. Upon the exportation of the greater part of commodities to other countries, half the old subsidy was drawn back. But this law enacted, that no part of that duty should be drawn back upon the exportation to the colonies of any commodities of the growth or manufacture either of Europe or the East Indies, except wines, white calicoes, and muslins.
p10.zh: 在除法国葡萄酒以外的所有葡萄酒的弊端中,对殖民地比对其他国家有利得多的同样行为,对其他商品的较大部分更不利。大部分商品出口到其他国家后,一半的旧补贴被收回。 但是,该法规定,除了葡萄酒、白卡利科酒和木林以外,不应将任何欧洲或东印度群岛的种植或制造商品出口到殖民地。

p11.original: Drawbacks were, perhaps, originally granted for the encouragement of the carrying trade, which, as the freight of the ship is frequently paid by foreigners in money, was supposed to be peculiarly fitted for bringing gold and silver into the country. But though the carrying trade certainly deserves no peculiar encouragement, though the motive of the institution was, perhaps, abundantly foolish, the institution itself seems reasonable enough. Such drawbacks cannot force into this trade a greater share of the capital of the country than what would have gone to it of its own accord, had there been no duties upon importation; they only prevent its being excluded altogether by those duties. The carrying trade, though it deserves no preference, ought not to be precluded, but to be left free, like all other trades. It is a necessary resource to those capitals which cannot find employment, either in the agriculture or in the manufactures of the country, either in its home trade, or in its foreign trade of consumption.
p11.zh: 也许,最初给予的退款是为了鼓励载货贸易,由于货船的运费经常由外国人用金钱支付,因此,应特别适合将金银运入该国。 但是,尽管这一贸易当然不值得任何特别的鼓励,尽管该机构的动机也许非常愚蠢,但该机构本身似乎足够合理。 如果进口时没有关税,这种弊端不能使国家资本占更大份额;它们只能防止被这些关税完全排除在外。承载贸易虽然不值得优先考虑,但不应被排除,而应像所有其他贸易一样,被允许自由进行。对于那些在农业或国家制造业、国内贸易或对外消费贸易中找不到就业机会的首都来说,这是必要的资源。

p12.original: The revenue of the customs, instead of suffering, profits from such drawbacks, by that part of the duty which is retained. If the whole duties had been retained, the foreign goods upon which they are paid could seldom have been exported, nor consequently imported, for want of a market. The duties, therefore, of which a part is retained, would never have been paid.
p12.zh: 海关的收入,而不是从这种缺陷中获利,因为所保留的那部分义务。 如果全部关税被保留,所付的外国货物就很少会出口,或者因为缺少市场而进口。 因此,保留一部分职责的,从来就没有支付过。

p13.original: These reasons seem sufficiently to justify drawbacks, and would justify them, though the whole duties, whether upon the produce of domestic industry or upon foreign goods, were always drawn back upon exportation. The revenue of excise would, in this case indeed, suffer a little, and that of the customs a good deal more; but the natural balance of industry, the natural division and distribution of labour, which is always more or less disturbed by such duties, would be more nearly re-established by such a regulation.
p13.zh: 这些理由似乎足以证明有不足之处,而且可以证明有不足之处,尽管全部义务,无论是对国内工业的产品还是对外国货物的责任,总是在出口时收回。 在这种情况下,消费收入确实会少一点,而海关的收入则会多一点;但是,工业的自然平衡、自然的分工和分工,总是受到这种义务的干扰,这种条例将更接近于重新确立。

p14.original: These reasons, however, will justify drawbacks only upon exporting goods to those countries which are altogether foreign and independent, not to those in which our merchants and manufacturers enjoy a monopoly. A drawback, for example, upon the exportation of European goods to our American colonies, will not always occasion a greater exportation than what would have taken place without it. By means of the monopoly which our merchants and manufacturers enjoy there, the same quantity might frequently, perhaps, be sent thither, though the whole duties were retained. The drawback, therefore, may frequently be pure loss to the revenue of excise and customs, without altering the state of the trade, or rendering it in any respect more extensive. How far such drawbacks can be justified as a proper encouragement to the industry of our colonies, or how far it is advantageous to the mother country that they should be exempted from taxes which are paid by all the rest of their fellow-subjects, will appear hereafter, when I come to treat of colonies.
p14.zh: 然而,这些理由只能证明向完全外国和独立的国家出口货物有缺陷,而不是向我们的商家和制造商享有垄断的国家出口货物有缺陷。 例如,在欧洲货物出口到我们的美洲殖民地时出现的一个缺点,并不总是能够比没有出口时出现的情况产生更大的出口。 我们的商人和制造商在那里享有垄断权,因此,尽管保留了全部义务,但同样的数量可能经常被发送。 因此,缺陷可能常常是消费和海关收入的纯损失,而不会改变贸易状况,或使贸易范围更广。今后,当我来处理殖民地问题时,这种弊端在多大程度上可以成为适当鼓励我们殖民地工业的正当理由,或者,对他们母国而言,对他们免除由所有其他同伴缴纳的税费,对母国来说,多么有利。

p15.original: Drawbacks, however, it must always be understood, are useful only in those cases in which the goods, for the exportation of which they are given, are really exported to some foreign country, and not clandestinely re-imported into our own. That some drawbacks, particularly those upon tobacco, have frequently been abused in this manner, and have given occasion to many frauds, equally hurtful both to the revenue and to the fair trader, is well known.
p15.zh: 然而,必须始终理解其缺点,只有在货物真正出口到某些外国而不是秘密再进口到我国的情况下才有用。众所周知,一些缺点,特别是烟草方面的缺点,经常被滥用,并给许多欺诈行为提供了机会,这些欺诈行为对收入和公平贸易者都同样有害。
